    {"step": 4, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "config_init_data", "line": 745, "var": "lexer.end", "code": ".end = (char *)data + len,", "note": "Lexer end = data + 32767; pos starts at data[0] = single quote.", "role": "propagation"},
    {"step": 5, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_config", "line": 459, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "if (chr == '\\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"''\", 2))", "note": "Input begins with triple single quote so lex_config detects the multiline string opener and dispatches to lex_multiline_string.", "role": "propagation", "phase": "format"},
    {"step": 6, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 342, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "advance_n(lexer, strlen(\"'''\") - 1);", "note": "pos advances by 2 past the opener; remaining 32765 'a' bytes contain no closing triple quote so the scan runs to the buffer end.", "role": "propagation"},
    {"step": 7, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_multiline_string", "line": 345, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) {", "note": "When pos reaches data+32766, strncmp reads 3 bytes: data[32766], data[32767], data[32768] - the last read is one past the 32768-byte static_data global array, causing a global-buffer-overflow READ 1.", "role": "root", "captures": {"pos_offset": "(long)(lexer->pos - lexer->start)", "end_offset": "(long)(lexer->end - lexer->start)"}, "condition": {"op": "ge", "left": "pos_offset", "right": "end_offset"}}
]

with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)
print("written")
